text:
leah: quick sync — need a call on Prompt Library MVP scope. Acme asked for SSO + tenant-scoped prompt sharing, but that adds ~3w. do we cut or shift to v1?
vik: quick estimates: core save/apply UX = 5d, promptstore API work = 4d, auth/tenancy + audit = 12d (compliance review).
leah: yeah. my proposed split: MVP = save + apply + simple perms (org-visible), v1 = tenant SSO + audit + analytics. keeps customer flows but avoids compliance hold. thoughts?
tamara: that reduces risk. main infra risk is the promptstore migration and embedding key collisions if we add sharing now. would prefer to land promptstore stable first.
juan: Acme specifically called out SSO and per-tenant visibility as blockers for pilot with their security team — they said they'd sign a pilot NDA and pay for early access. they need audit logs for initial 5 tenants though.
leah: interesting — trade: small revenue + more compliance work vs later broader GA. do we accept a paid canary that includes SSO only for Acme? canary scope = SSO + audit for 5 tenants, behind flag.
vik: technically doable as a canary: feature flag + dedicated config for 5 tenant IDs. estimate for canary path (config + audit hooks + rollout automation) = 7d, plus 2d QA. still need to isolate data paths.
tamara: QA needs an explicit rollback plan. recommend: rollout -> monitor 48h -> if error_rate > 2% or latency 99p > 500ms rollback. also require smoke test script in CI.
leah: agreed. proposal: MVP public = save/apply/org-visible; canary=Acme-only SSO+audit behind flag; v1 = broad SSO + analytics.
juan: i'll take Acme comms and the NDA. can confirm they accept canary limitation if we promise audit exports for 30d.
vik: assigned: vik -> canary infra + feature flag automation (7d), tamara -> promptstore stability + smoke tests (5d), leah -> product docs + guardrails.
leah: timeline suggestion: start dev Mon (4387720000), canary deploy target in 2 weeks (4388880000). if anything urgent pops, escalate in #release-war-room.
leah: decision check — everyone OK with MVP split + paid canary? :thinking_face:
vik: ok from eng.
tamara: ok, but add explicit rollback playbook in PR description.
juan: ok, i'll get Acme sign-off.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for feature/pm/prompt-library -> staging on 4387800000, notify #release-war-room on deploy finish.
leah: great — will follow up with a short RFC and the cutlist (what we defer to v1) by EOD. thanks all :shipit:
